'''Collector barges''' were [[Ssi-ruu]]vi vehicles. [[D'kee-class landing ship]]s carried ten collector barges. They were crewed by [[P'w'eck]]s and were used to collect [[Paralysis canister|paralysis gas]] victims for eventual [[entechment]].
